required_outcomes: Updates NBL-008-3466: the bedroom carpet is out of scope because the landlord's own fitter (Dev Langley) will supply and fit it; no contractor is approved yet.

Asks both Eliza Bennett and Kendall Building Services for revised prices for the same reduced scope (everything except the bedroom carpet), noting the carpet will be fitted by someone else after the decorating.
Holds the job for the revised quotes with a review date and a dated follow-up, and tells Mr Langley what has been requested and when he can expect the figures.
acceptable_alternatives: Telling the landlord that Kendall's itemised quote implies about £1,180 plus VAT (£1,416) without the carpet, as an indication only, while still asking Kendall to confirm.
Asking the landlord for Dev Langley's contact details and confirming that keys are signed out at the office.
positive_behaviours: Notes that the landlord's own fitter is his responsibility (insurance, quality), and that he should be booked after the decorating so the new carpet is not painted over.
Mentions that each further week empty costs rent, without pressing.
Notes the quotes' validity (Kendall to 31 October, Eliza to 6 November).
red_flags: Works out a revised figure for Eliza from the other quote instead of asking her.
Asks only one contractor to re-quote, so the landlord cannot compare like with like.
prohibited_actions: Instructing either contractor before the landlord chooses from the revised prices.
critical_failures: Instructs a contractor, or leaves the job with no re-quote request and no follow-up.
